newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN upgrades three insurers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN upgrades three insurers.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc upgraded three insurance firms: Intercargo Corp, American General Corp and USLIFE Corp, all of which were rated market performer, to outperform for the long term.
-- EVEREN cited higher price targets and an improved interest rate environment for insurance stocks for the upgrades.
-- The group had underperformed because interest rates were rising and more increases were expected, said EVEREN.
-- Intercargo stock was up 1/4 at 8-3/8; American General was unchanged at 41-3/8; USLIFE was up 1/2 at 30-7/8.
